claims: Reports from April 19-20, 2026 indicated Brock Lesnar appeared to retire from WWE at WrestleMania 42.
Brock Lesnar lost to Oba Femi at WrestleMania 42.
Brock Lesnar removed his gloves and shoes in the ring.
Brock Lesnar waved goodbye to the crowd.
Subsequent reports cited Brock Lesnar stating he is retired.
Brock Lesnar kissed the ring after losing to Oba Femi.
Brock Lesnar acknowledged fans after losing to Oba Femi.
Social media and news reports indicated that a fan approached Brock Lesnar.
Brock Lesnar reportedly confirmed 'He\'s not [returning], and that he\'s retired'.
Brock Lesnar's retirement was not officially announced via a formal WWE press release immediately.
Brock Lesnar's second major WWE run was 2021–2026.
Speculation in March 2026 suggested Brock Lesnar's retirement might take place at SummerSlam.
Brock Lesnar became the youngest wrestler to hold a WWE world championship.
Brock Lesnar defeated The Rock at SummerSlam that August.
Brock Lesnar was 25 years old when he defeated The Rock at SummerSlam.
